αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αὐτοὺς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ (grave, mid-clause form)
αὐτοῖσι: αὐτός — self; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’for them, to them’ (dat. of persons served) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἀμφ’ αὐτοῖσι ’around them’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’) · also masc. gen. sg. after περί: ’about himself’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun governed by ἄγχι ’near’: ’him’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτοῦ ’close beside him’) · also gen. sg. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’with him himself still living’ (αὐτοῦ ζώοντος) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, ’him’, governed by ἰθύς: ’straight towards him’ (ἰθὺς κίεν αὐτοῦ)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῆμαρ: αὐτῆμαρ — on that very day; adv. (αὐτός + ἦμαρ)
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλλ: βάλλω — throw, cast, put; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βάλλ’ = βάλλε; Attic ἔβαλλε)
βέλος: βέλος — missile, thing thrown; neut. acc. sg. (here a hurled rock) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’missile’ (βέλος Ἀντινόοιο ’the missile of Antinous’) · also neut. acc. sg., an arrow: ’shaft’ (θοὸν βέλος ’swift shaft’)
βασιλεὺς: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. nom. sg.
βασιλῆϊ: βασιλεύς — king; masc. dat. sg., epic -ῆϊ (= Attic βασιλεῖ)
βιοῖο: βιός — bow; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ); a poetic word = τόξον, not βίος ’life’
βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.
βούλεται: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; pres. 3 sg. mid., + inf.: ’wants’
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
γένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, come to pass; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐγένοντο)
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg. · also γέρων — old, aged (adj.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σάκος: ’old’ (σάκος … γέρον ’an old shield’)
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg.
δέχεσθαι: δέχομαι — receive, welcome; pres. inf. mid.: ’to receive’ (a guest)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δαναοὶ: Δαναοί — the Danaans, one of Homer’s names for the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
δαναοῖσι: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δαναοῖσιν: Δαναοί — the Danaans (a name for the Greeks); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δεινὴ: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; fem. nom. sg.
δεκάτῃ: δέκατος — tenth; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with νυκτί: ’on the tenth (night)’ · also fem. dat. sg. with ἡμέρῃ understood: ’on the tenth (day)’
δερκομένοιο: δέρκομαι — see, look; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου): ’seeing’
διός: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; gen. sg. (stem Δι-)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’) · also prep. + gen., ’through’ (διὰ πτόλιος ’through the city’) · also in tmesis with ἧκε (διὰ … ἧκε = διῆκε ’shot through’) · also in tmesis with ἦλθε (διὰ … ἦλθε = διῆλθε ’went through’)
δοῖεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they give’ · also aor. opt. 3 pl. in a protasis after εἰ: ’if they should give’
δόμεναι: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεναι, used as imperative: ’give’ · also inf. after ὀτρύνω, ’to give’ (πομπὴν ὀτρύνω δόμεναι ’I urge (him) to give a conveyance’) · also inf. complementing an impersonal ’it seemed better’: ’to give’ (κέρδιον εἶναι … δόμεναι ’better to give’) · also inf. after the impersonal χρή: ’to give’ (σε χρὴ δόμεναι ’you ought to give’) · also inf. complementing ἔτλης: ’to bring oneself to give’ · also inf. after φθονέω: ’(do not) begrudge giving’ (οὔτε τινὰ φθονέω δόμεναι) · also inf. after ἐάω, ’to give’ (οὐκ ἐάσουσιν … δόμεναι ’they will not allow (it) to be given’) · also inf. complementing ἐθέλω, ’(if I) wish to give’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλωμι … δόμεναι) · also inf. after ὁμοκλέομεν, negated by μή: ’(shouted) not to give’ (τόξον μὴ δόμεναι)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’) · also ὡς εἰ, ’as if’, before a noun with no verb of its own (ὡς εἰ κέρα … ἠὲ σίδηρος ’as if horn or iron’)
εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’ · also in ὡς εἴ τε with no verb or optative expressed: ’as if’
εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
εἴπῃς: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 2 sg., purpose with ὄφρα
εὐχόμενος: εὔχομαι — pray, vow, boast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’praying’
εὔχεται: εὔχομαι — claim, boast, profess; pres. 3 sg.: ’claims (to be)’ · also pray, + dat.: ’prays’ (Διὶ δ’ εὔχεται ’and to Zeus he prays’)
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle · also with the relative ὅθι, no connective force: ὅθι θ’ ’where’ · also epic τε after a relative, no connective force (οὕς θ’ ’which’) · also epic τε after οὐδέ, no connective force: οὐδέ θ’ ἅλεσσι ’nor … with salt’
θάνατόν: θάνατος — death; masc. acc. sg., enclitic accent before τε: ’death’ · also accented before the enclitic γε: θάνατόν γε ’death at least’
θαρσήσας: θαρσέω — take courage, be bold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken courage’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖο: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ) · also of a goddess, θεός being common in gender
θοὰς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with νῆας: ’swift (ships)’
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θῆκε: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθηκε)
θῖνα: θίς — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὃς δέ κ’ … ἵκηται ’whoever comes’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κ’ ἐλθὼν … εἴποιμι ’and I would go and tell’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καί νύ κ’ … ἔδυ ’and … would have set’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (τοὺς δέ κ’ … θέλξει ’and then … will enchant them’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ μέν κ’ αἰνήσωσι ’if they approve’) · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (τόν κ’ εἴ μοι δοίης ’if you would give me him’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κ’ αὐτὸν γνώω ’if I come to know him’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κ’ … ἐρεθίζω ’so that I may provoke’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κ’ … ἵκηται ’so that he may reach’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if you should wish’ (αἴ κ’ ἐθέλῃσθα)
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + aor. indic., unreal past: κέν μοι … κατέχευας ’you would have poured on me’ · also + subj. in a main clause: ’may’ (καί κέν οἱ ὑπέρσχῃ χεῖρα ’and he may hold his hand over him’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (κέν μοι … εἴη ’would be mine’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέν τις … ὀρέξῃ ’if perhaps someone holds out’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν … μεταλλῶσιν ’whenever they ask’) · also + opt., potential, in a clause with ὅ ’that’: ’might’ (ὅ κέν τις … ἀμύνοι ’that someone might defend’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … would’ (ὥς κέν τις φαίη ’so that anyone would say’) · also + subj. in a clause with εἰς ὅτε, ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι)
κήδετο: κήδω — trouble; mid. κήδομαι + gen. ’care for’; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκήδετο)
κακῶς: κακός — bad, evil; adv.: ’wickedly, shamefully’ · also ’miserably, in misery’ (ὀψὲ κακῶς ἔλθοι ’may he come late, in misery’)
καρήνων: κάρηνον — head, peak, summit; neut. gen. pl.
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’) · also + acc., of place, ’along’ (κατ’ ἠερόεντα κέλευθα ’along the misty paths’) · also + acc., ‘over against’ (κατ’ ἄντηστιν ‘right opposite’)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’) · also + acc., of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’on the right shoulder’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a main clause: ’will’ (αἶψά κε … ἀποτίσεται ’at once he will exact payment’) · also + aor. in a general relative clause: ’who would (decide)’ (οἵ κε … ἔκριναν) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ’whoever might’ (ὅς κε … πόροι ’whoever might offer’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κε … ἐντανύσῃς) · also + subj. in an indirect clause after ὅττι: ’what … may’ (ὅττι κε κέρδος … ἐγγυαλίξῃ ’what gain … may grant’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν ἔλθω ’until I come’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause or an indirect disjunctive question: ’shall’ (ἤ κεν … δυνησόμεθ’ ’whether we shall be able’) · also + fut. indic. in a relative clause: ’who will’ (ὅς κεν … ἐποίσει ’who will lay on’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κεν … καταθείομαι ’so that I may put away’) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … πάσχῃ ’so that he may suffer’) · also + subj. in the second half of an indirect disjunctive question: ’or whether’ (ἦέ κεν ἀγνοιῇσι ’or whether he will fail to know’)
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κλαγγὴ: κλαγγή — clamour, shrill cry, din; fem. nom. sg.
κλῦθί: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg., + gen.: ’hear me!’
κνίσης: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — savour of burning fat; fem. gen. sg., Ionic η (= Attic κνίσης): ’of the fat’
κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
κρατερὸν: κρατερός — strong, mighty (by-form of καρτερός); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος as subject
κρείσσων: κρατύς — strong; comparative κρείσσων, stronger, mightier (= Attic κρείττων); masc. nom. sg.
κότον: κότος — grudge, rancour, wrath; masc. acc. sg.
κύνας: κύων — dog; masc./fem. acc. pl. (of sea creatures, perhaps dogfish) · also fem. acc. pl. as a term of abuse for shameless women: ’shameless creatures, bitches’ (of maidservants)
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’ · also κήρ — death-fate, doom; fem. acc. sg., elided (κῆρ’ = κῆρα): ’death-fate’ (θάνατον καὶ κῆρ’ ’death and doom’) · also neut. acc. sg., after ἀμφί: ’around the heart’ · also neut. acc. sg., direct object with a predicate adjective: ’heart’ (κῆρ ἀτέραμνον ἔθηκαν ’made the heart unyielding’)
λέχος: λέχος — bed, couch; neut. nom./acc. sg.
λίσσετο: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat, pray to; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐλίσσετο)
λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’ · also gen. governed by πρόσθεν: ’before (the city and) the people’ · also gen. governed by φείδεο ’spare’: ’spare your people’ (φείδεο λαῶν σῶν)
λευκώλενος: λευκώλενος — white-armed; adj., nom. sg. (epithet of women, e.g. Nausicaa)
λητώ: Λητώ — Leto, mother of Apollo and Artemis; nom. sg.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μάντιν: μάντις — seer, prophet; masc. acc. sg.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)
μετέειπεν: μετεῖπον — speak among, address a group (poetic aor., defective); aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μετέφη: μετάφημι — speak among, address a group; aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’) · also + dat. of the hands, ’in’ (μετὰ χερσὶν ἐνώμα ’was turning in his hands’)
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’) · also gen. sg. with a participle: ’of me hearing’ (μευ ἀκούοντος, with φίλον ἦτορ ’heart’) · also gen. with κήδομαι: ’care for me’ (ἦ μευ … κήδεαι ’you care for me’)
μηρί: μηρίον — thigh-piece, burned as an offering; neut. acc. pl., elided (μηρί’ = μηρία)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’) · also dat. of possession with a noun: ’my’ (νηῦς δέ μοι ἥδ’ ἕστηκεν ’this ship of mine stands’)
μυθήσασθαι: μυθέομαι — speak, tell, declare; aor. inf. mid.
μυρί: μυρίος — countless, numberless; neut. acc. pl., elided (μυρί’ = μυρία), agreeing with ὀνείατα
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὰ: μά — by (in oaths, + acc. of the one sworn by); particle: οὐ μά ‘no, by …’
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῆνιν: μῆνις — wrath, lasting anger (esp. a god’s); fem. acc. sg.
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νήεσσ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., elided (νήεσσ’ = νήεσσι), epic (= Attic ναυσί)
νεκύων: νεκύς — dead man, corpse; masc. gen. pl.
νεῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl. (= epic νηῶν)
νηυσί: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί), here without ν-movable
νηυσὶ: ναῦς — ship; dat. pl., epic νηυσί (= Attic ναυσί)
νηὸν: ναός (epic νηός) — temple, shrine; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ναόν)
νοῦσον: νοῦσος — sickness, disease; fem. acc. sg., Ionic (= Attic νόσος)
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νῆας: ναῦς — ship; fem. acc. pl., epic νῆας (= Attic ναῦς)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’) · also encl. dat. sg. of the possessor with a body part: ’his’ (ἀνὰ ῥῖνας δέ οἱ ’up his nostrils’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκαδ: οἴκαδε (elided οἴκαδ’) — homeward, to home; adv., -δε suffix of direction
οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλομένην: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. part. mid. οὐλόμενος used as adj., ’accursed, ruinous’; fem. acc. sg.
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj. · also ’that’, introducing what a messenger is to tell (= ὅτι): ἐρέοντα … οὕνεκα ’to tell that’
οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. agreeing with a noun (οὗ πατρὸς ’her own father’s’)
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα: ’fat’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’rich’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’) · also + acc., ’beside, contrary to’ (παρὰ μοῖραν ’beside what is fitting’)
πατρὶ: πατήρ — father; masc. dat. sg., governed by ὁμοῖοι ’like’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person told: ’to (her) father’ (ἀγγείλειε ... πατρὶ φίλῳ ’report to her dear father’) · also masc. dat. sg. in apposition to Zeus: Διὶ πατρὶ ’to father Zeus’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the god prayed to: εὔχεο πατρὶ Ποσειδάωνι ’pray to your father Poseidon’ · also masc. dat. sg. after παρά: ’beside (their) father’ (παρὰ πατρὶ φίλῳ) · also masc. dat. sg. object of χαριζόμενος: ’pleasing (his own) father’ · also masc. dat. sg. of the person one is angry at: πατρὶ χολωθείς ’angered at his father’
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
πηληϊάδεω: Πηληϊάδης — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολλὰς: πολύς — much, many; fem. acc. pl., accent grave mid-clause
πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’ · also epic πολλόν (= πολύν), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’long (time)’
πολυφλοίσβοιο: πολύφλοισβος — loud-roaring; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
πρίν: πρίν — before, until; conj./adv., + inf. (like Attic πρίν) · also + a temporal clause (πρίν γ’ ὅτ’ ἄν + subj.): ’until the time when’ · also πρίν κε + opt., an independent potential clause answering a suppressed protasis: ’sooner, before then’ (πρίν κεν ... ἵκοιο ’you would arrive home before then’) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article, no inf.: ’formerly, at first’ (parallel to the by-form πρὶν) · also πρίν γ’ ὅτε + aor. indic.: ’until the time when’ (a definite past terminus) · also πρίν γε + subj.: ’until’ (πρίν γ’ ἔτι … πειρήσεαι ’until you have tried’)
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
πρό: πρό — before, beforehand; adv./prep.; also a preverb in tmesis (πρό … εἴπομεν = προείπομεν ’we told beforehand’)
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’) · also adv. ’till then, before that’ in a clause with no finite verb (πρὶν δ’ οὔ τι νεμεσσητὸν κεχολῶσθαι ’till then it is no cause for blame to be angry’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’)
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σοῖσι: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σφωε: σφωέ — they two, the two of them; epic dual pron., acc. (= Attic αὐτώ)
σύνθεο: συντίθημι — put together; mid. take to heart, mark; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic σύνθου)
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’ · also after ἤ ’than’, with no connective force: ἤ τ’ οἰωνοί ’than birds’ · also after ὅ ‘that’, with no connective force: ὅ τ’ οὐκέτι νόστιμός ἐστιν ‘that he is no longer returning’ · also epic τε after ὥς in a simile, with no connective force (ὥς τ’ αἰετός ’like an eagle’) · also epic τε after ἵνα ’where’, with no connective force (ἵνα τ’ ’where’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.; also relative: ’which’ (accented τά before a following enclitic) · also article-like with ἄλλα, ’the other (things)’ (τά περ ἄλλα ’in the other matters’) · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) within’ (τά τ’ ἔνδοθι)
τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
τήν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg., resumptive: ’whom’ · also demonstrative, fem. acc. sg., resuming an earlier noun: ’her’ (τήν … ῥέξω ’her I will sacrifice’) · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὀιζυῖ πολλῇ, τήν μοι ἐπῶρσε ’great misery, which he roused for me’) · also demonstrative with a noun and adjective: ’that’ (τήν γε στυγερὴν ὁδόν ’that hateful journey’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’) · also fem. nom. sg. interrogative adjective with a noun: ’what?’ (τίς … ἡμέρη ’what day?’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσσῃ: τελέω — accomplish, fulfil; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic τελέσῃ), with κε in a protasis after αἴ: ’if … should accomplish’
τεῦχε: τεύχω — make, prepare, build; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτευχε)
τηλόθι: τηλόθι — far off, far away; epic adv. with suffix -θι, + gen.: ’far from’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’) · also neut. acc. sg. as object with a negative: ’anything’ (οὐδέ τι ῥέξαι ’nor to have done anything’)
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὔνεκ: τοὔνεκα — for that reason, on that account (τοῦ ἕνεκα); adv., elided (τοὔνεκ’)
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’ · also τοι, the affirming particle (ἀλλ’ ἦ τοι ’but truly’), as the grave-accented form τοὶ
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’) · also masc. gen. sg., of a thing just named: ’from it, from this’ (ἐκ δὲ τοῦ, of the bedpost)
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον, acc. of duration: ’so long’ (τόσσον χρόνον ’so long a time’)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective, neut.: ’the (worse things)’ (τὰ χέρεια) · also neut. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cow and the goats · also article-like before an adverb, ’the (things) outside’ (τὰ θύρηφι)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’) · also article-like before an infinitive, which it makes a noun: ’the (keeping watch)’ (τὸ φυλάσσειν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. acc. sg., object of its clause (τὸ πρὶν μέν ῥ’ ἐφόρει ’which he used to carry before’) · also demonstrative, neut. acc. sg., object of a verb: ’this, that’ (τὸ δὲ νήπιοι οὐκ ἐνόησαν ’but the fools did not perceive this’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. sg.: ’her, with her’ · also adverbial, ’there, in that place’, pointing back to a place just named (τῇ τόν γε μένον λοχόωντες ’there they lay in wait for him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., serving as an instrumental, ’with which’ (ῥάβδον, τῇ τ’ ἀνδρῶν ὄμματα θέλγει ’a wand, with which he charms men’s eyes’), not the personal pronoun · also relative adv., ’where, in the place where’ (τῇ δή μοι ἐείσατο χῶρος ἄριστος) · also adverbial, ’in that (event)’, pointing back to a contest just named: τῇ δ’ αὖτ’ Εὐρύαλος ἀπεκαίνυτο ’in that Euryalus in turn outdid all’ · also relative adv. of manner, with περ: ’in just the way that’ · also adv. of direction, ’thither, that way’ · also with a noun, article-like: fem. dat. sg. ’the’ (τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of respect or means: ’in which, by which’ (ἀγλαΐην, τῇ … κέκασσαι ’the beauty by which you excel’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’upon whom’ (τῇ τις θεὸς ὕπνον ἐπῶρσε ’upon whom some god has stirred up sleep’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’) · also adverbial, with κε: ’in that case, otherwise’ (τῷ κέ μιν … παύσαμεν ’otherwise we should have stopped him’)
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
φίλην: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. acc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν) · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
φαρέτρην: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (Ionic η for α; Attic φαρέτρᾱν)
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φράσαι: φράζομαι — consider, think out, take thought; aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’consider’ · also aor. imper. mid. with the eyes: ’observe, take note of’ (οὐλὴν … φράσαι ὀφθαλμοῖσι ’observe this scar with your eyes’)
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρονέων: φρονέω — think, intend, be disposed; pres. part. nom. sg. masc., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονῶν)
φύγοιμεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. 1 pl., in a purpose clause: ’that we might escape’ · also aor. opt. 1 pl. with κεν, after a subjunctive in the same ἵνα clause: ’so that we might escape’ (ἤ κεν … φύγοιμεν)
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χρυσέῳ: χρύσεος — golden; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσῷ)
χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
χόλον: χόλος — anger, wrath (lit. gall, bile); acc. sg.
ψυχὰς: ψυχή — life, spirit, soul; fem. acc. pl.

ἀγαμέμνονι: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. dat. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
ἀγορήσατο: ἀγοράομαι — speak in the assembly; aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’unseemly things’ (ἀεικέα μερμηρίζων ’pondering unseemly things’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly, shabby (wallet)’ · also neut. acc. pl., attributive: ’shameful (deeds)’ (ἀεικέα ἔργ’) · also fem. acc. sg. (one form for masc. and fem.), agreeing with πήρην: ’unseemly’ (ἀεικέα πήρην ’an unseemly wallet’)
ἀκέων: ἀκέων — silent, in silence; adj., masc. nom. sg., used adverbially: ’silently’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμύμων: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (an old epithet whose exact force is uncertain); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀμῦναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. act., infin. of purpose: ’to ward off’
ἀνάσσεις: ἀνάσσω — rule, be lord (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. · also + dat., ’rule over’ (θεοῖσι καὶ ἀνθρώποισιν ἀνάσσεις)
ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’) · also as adverb, no case: ’upon (them), thereon’ (ἔνθα δ’ ἀνὰ σταφυλαὶ ἔασιν ’and there upon them are grapes of every kind’)
ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
ἀπέλυσε: ἀπολύω — loose, untie, set free; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’unfastened’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπονοστήσειν: ἀπονοστέω — return home, come back; fut. inf. act.: ’that (you) will return’
ἀπριάτην: ἀπρίατος — unbought, unpurchased; fem. acc. sg. used as an adverb (it cannot agree with masc. με or ἥρως): ‘without price, freely’; the usual explanation, not certain
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργυρέοιο: ἀργύρεος — of silver; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -οιο (= Attic ἀργυροῦ)
ἀρνῶν: ἀρήν — lamb; gen. pl. (oblique stem ἀρν-)
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀτρεΐδῃ: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, of Agamemnon); masc. dat. sg.
ἀφίει: ἀφίημι — let go, let fly; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἠφίει)
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλεῦ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. voc. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλεῦ)
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆος: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. gen. sg., single-λ epic (= Attic Ἀχιλλέως)
ἁζόμενοι: ἅζομαι — stand in awe of, revere; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’out of awe’
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. inf. act.
ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄμμε: ἐγώ — I; acc. pl. ’us’, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’ · also ἄρ before an elided κ’ (κε), ’then’, in a question: ἦ ἄρ κ’ ἐθέλοις ’would you then be willing?’ · also the shortened ἄρ before a consonant, without elision: ’then’ (ἐπεὶ ἄρ βλέφαρ’ … ἀμφικαλύψῃ ’when then (sleep) has covered the eyelids’) · also ἄρ before ἕζετ’ without elision: ’then’ (κατ’ ἄρ ἕζετ’ ’then sat down’)
ἄργεϊ: Ἄργος — Argos; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἐέλδωρ: ἐέλδωρ — wish, desire; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμεῦ: ἐγώ — I; gen. sg., epic (= Attic ἐμοῦ): ’from me’ · also gen. as object of a verb of remembering: μνήσῃ ἐμεῦ ’you may remember me’ · also gen. with ἀέκητι: ’(against) my (will)’ (ἐμεῦ ἀέκητι) · also gen. after δαήσεαι ’learn’: ’about me’ (ἐμεῦ … δαήσεαι)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
ἐμὰ: ἐμός — my, mine; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’) · also + acc., ’in pursuit of, after’ (ἐπ’ ἀγροτέρας ’after wild (goats)’) · also + dat., ’in favour of, on behalf of’ (ἐπ’ Ἴρῳ ἦρα φέρων ’showing favour to Irus’) · also + acc. of time: ’for’ (ἐπ’ ἦμαρ ’for a day’) · also + gen., of place: ’at, on’ (ἐπ’ ἐσχατιῆς ’at the edge’) · also + dat., of place: ’at, by’ (ἐπ’ Ὠκεανῷ ’at Oceanus’)
ἐπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, be persuaded, believe; impf. mid. 3 sg.: ’was persuaded’
ἐποίσει: ἐπιφέρω — bring upon, lay on; fut. 3 sg. (with κε): ’will lay on’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’) · also + dat., of purpose: ’for’ (ἐπὶ δόρπῳ ’for supper’) · also + dat., of the occasion: ’at, over’ (ἐπὶ ῥηθέντι δικαίῳ ’at a fair remark’)
ἐπῴχετο: ἐποίχομαι — go to and fro to, come round to; impf. 3 sg.
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐτελείετο: τελέω — fulfil, accomplish; impf. pass. 3 sg., epic -είετο (= Attic ἐτελεῖτο): ’was being fulfilled’
ἐχώσατο: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; aor. 3 sg.
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with θύρετρα ’doors’: καὶ εὐρέα περ ἐόντα ’wide though they are’
ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
ἑκατόμβην: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, great sacrifice (originally of a hundred oxen); fem. acc. sg.
ἑκατόμβης: ἑκατόμβη — hecatomb, large sacrifice (lit. of a hundred oxen); gen. sg.
ἑοῖσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive; Homeric ἑός, = Attic ἑαυτοῦ, ἴδιος) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις); not the relative
ἔθηκε: τίθημι — put, place, cause, bring about; aor. 3 sg., augmented (root θη-/θε-, consonant-initial; unaugmented θῆκε): ’set, caused’ (ἔριν ἔθηκε ’set strife’)
ἔκλυε: κλύω — hear, hearken to, heed; aor. 3 sg. (+ gen. of person heard)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔπεισιν: ἔπειμι (εἶμι + ἐπί) — go over, go among, inspect; pres. 3 sg., used with future sense alongside ἀριθμήσει: ’(will) go among (them), inspect’
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπεσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι), ν-movable: ’with words’
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχει: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 sg. · also intransitive with an adverb, ’be in a state’: εὖ … κομιδὴ ἔχει ’the tending is in good order’
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
ἡμετέρῳ: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε) · also ’than’ after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖον … ἢ Ὀδυσῆ’ ’another … than Odysseus’) · also the first of two alternatives: ’either … or’ (ἢ στοναχῆς ἠὲ κτύπου ’either groaning or noise’)
ἢν: ἐάν (ἤν) — if (= εἰ + ἄν); conj. + subj.; ἢν μή ’unless’
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤγερθεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἠγέρθησαν): ’were gathered’
ἥνδανε: ἁνδάνω — please, be pleasing to; impf. 3 sg., augmented (η- from the root’s original digamma, contracted; the same augment as the uncontracted ἑήνδανε in this part; unaugmented ἄνδανε); + dat.: ’was pleasing to’
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἰφθίμους: ἴφθιμος — stout, mighty; masc. acc. pl.
ἰόντα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going, as he goes’
ἰὸν: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (a different word from ἰός ’poison, rust’)
ἱερὴν: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic ἱεράν)
ἱκέσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; aor. inf.
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἶφι: ἶφι — mightily, by force; adv. (instrumental -φι of ἴς)
ὀΐομαι: ὀΐω — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. mid., epic ὀΐομαι: ’I think’ (+ acc. and inf.)
ὀΐω: ὀΐομαι — think, suppose; pres. 1 sg. (act. form ὀΐω, epic; = Attic οἴομαι): ’I think’
ὀλύμπια: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη) · also neut. acc. sg. relative, referring back to a thing, object of δῶκας: ’which (you gave me)’ · also = ὅτι ’that’, neut. acc. sg., introducing a clause after a verb of knowing (ὃ δὴ κακὰ μήδετο ’that evils were being devised’) · also neut. nom. sg. relative of a thing, subject of ἐστι: ’that which, whatever’ (ὃ κάλλιστον … ἐστι ’the one that is fairest’) · also neut. acc. sg. relative as a connective, ’for which reason, which is why’ (ὃ καὶ μεταμώνια βάζεις ’which is why you speak idly’) · also neut. nom. sg., demonstrative/connective, subject of ἐστί: ’that’ (ὃ γὰρ γέρας ἐστί ’for that is the due’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄναρ: ὄναρ — dream, vision seen in sleep (opposed to ὕπαρ); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὄχ: ὄχα — by far, exceedingly; adv., elided (ὄχ’ = ὄχα), intensifying a superlative (ὄχ’ ἄριστα ’far the best’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’ · also introducing a wish with the optative: ’so may…’ (ὣς ἔμ’ ἀϊστώσειαν ’so may they make me vanish’)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’) · also ὥς accented before enclitic οἱ, of measure: ’as much as’ (ὥς οἱ χεῖρες ἐχάνδανον ’as much as his hands could hold’) · also exclamatory, ’how’, accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τις θαρσαλέος … ἐσσι ’how bold you are’) · also with the plain optative (no κε/ἄν), purpose, accented before the enclitic μιν: ’so that’ (ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι ’so that life should leave him’) · also ὡς ’as, how’, accented before enclitic μοι (ὥς μοι ἰνδάλλεται ’as it seems to me’) · also ὡς ’how’, introducing a narrated event, accented before the enclitic μιν (ὥς μιν θηρεύοντ’ ἔλασεν ’how he struck him as he hunted’) · also ὡς ’as, like’, accented before enclitic τις (ὥς τις ’like some’)
ᾔδη: οἶδα — know; plpf. 3 sg. with past sense (= impf.): ’knew’
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
